The '''Dawnsorrow rifle''' was a rifle meant to provide an edge against the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. By the time of [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], those weapons were no longer issued, but became highly prized.
